steps.name: Epilogue ~ Land of Welcome ~
steps.objective: Listen to the stories of guests who came to [Siam] and complete the quest.

lines.text: (In an empty space, Siam, who was alone, feels someone's presence.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Who is there?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Kazno, it’s been a while.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Since you never talk for a long time, I will ask first. Is there anyone else other than you who came with me?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Kazno recommended it to me, and it exceeded my expectations, wizard. Even though I hide my presence, you still notice me well, right?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Siam… .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: This guy needs your help.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Yes, a wizard from another world. There's something me and Kazno want to know. Just answer the questions and you won't do anything.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I promise. I'm not a savage animal so I won't harm you.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: You definitely feel different. But the promise you made… , What kind of contract is this?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It may or may not be similar. You can offer as much as you want. It may vary depending on who you choose and what method you take.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I understand. Then I will tell you a story about another world that you want to know about.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Great! Wizards are different after all. You already knew. Then tell me about ‘A▒▒L’!

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It’s the name of a star I haven’t heard in a long time. I came... .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Azrael... . It means ‘the star chosen by God’s angel.’ Huh, Kazno… . Are you going?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I'll just go now. I just brought someone with me who had some business to see to you.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Oh, before I go, can I ask you one thing? The choice at that time... .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Just like you, I have no regrets. … .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Kazno, goodbye. I'm going to hear more about the star from this guy.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: And don't die until you find the snake. Shouldn't that couple get back together again? There's still a lot to do, so take care of yourself.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Useless words... . Then I will go.
(Kazno disappears and Siam and Jeril talk for a long time. Jeril looks satisfied.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Thank you. Thanks to you, it helped me a lot. Once this is over, ‘Etoire’ will change in the direction everyone wants.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I don't know what that means... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: At least it will be better than now. Oh, you look like you want to ask me this time? Tell me, what are you curious about?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: By any chance, he too… Is it Agashra?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Because of fate, I had no choice but to become real... , just like that guy I used to know.
